name: among us detailed design
design:
A professional 2D character turnaround sheet of a yellow crewmate (Among Us style), including front, back, left profile, and right profile views. A clean isometric sci-fi environment in a flat 2D Flash animation style.

Scene:
[여기에 장면 설명 넣기 — 예: spaceship hangar, control room, factory, soccer field, etc.]

Composition:
- multi-level structure with clear height difference (foreground platform + lower level)
- strong sense of depth using perspective layering
- camera angle slightly top-down isometric view (around 30–45 degrees)

Characters:
- Among Us style crewmates (yellow, red, etc.)
- simple capsule-shaped bodies
- no visible arms
- small backpack on the back
- glossy blue visor with highlight
- placed naturally interacting with the environment

Line style:
- thick, uniform black outlines
- clean vector lines (no sketch, no jitter, no broken lines)
- consistent stroke width everywhere (Flash animation style)

Color:
- slightly desaturated color palette
- no overly saturated or neon colors
- clean flat colors with minimal soft shading
- no noisy textures, no grain

Lighting:
- simple and even lighting
- no dramatic shadows, no realism

Environment design:
- futuristic machinery with simplified geometric shapes
- avoid complex realistic details
- use clean panels, pipes, consoles, platforms
- all props redesigned uniquely (no repetition of previous shapes)

Style:
- flat cel-shaded 2D
- vector illustration look
- Flash animation / Toon Boom style
- game asset quality

Depth:
- clear separation between upper platform and lower area
- use shadows and scaling to enhance depth
- railings, stairs, or edges to show level difference

Avoid:
- realistic rendering
- painterly textures
- messy outlines
- noise / grain / rough brush
- over-detailed surfaces

Body proportions:
- height about 2.5x the width
- rounded top, flat bottom feet
- legs separated with a small gap
- no visible arms

Backpack:
- rectangular with rounded corners
- centered on upper back
- same color as body with slightly darker shading

Visor:
- large horizontal oval
- placed slightly above center of the body
- glossy light blue gradient with white highlight on top-left

Linework:
- thick, uniform black outline
- smooth and clean, no sketchiness

Color:
- soft warm yellow (slightly desaturated)
- subtle shading on lower body and edges
- no texture, no noise

Style:
- flat cel-shaded cartoon
- clean vector-like finish
- similar to mobile game character design

Background:
- pure white

Avoid:
- realistic rendering
- 3D shading
- high detail textures
- lighting effects
- extra props or decorations
